name: Peshwa Wheat Limited
about: Peshwa Wheat Limited engages in the business of processing of wheat-based products and allied flour products in India. The company processes Atta  wheat flour, Sortex Wheat, Broken Wheat, Wheat Bran and other flour products such as Gram Flour (Besan) and Maize Flour. It sells its products under the Shahi Peshwa, Peshwa Maharaj, Royal Peshwa, and Peshwa Gold brand names. The company markets and sells its products in B2B segment in the states of Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Gujarat. Its products are sold to Super Stockists who supplies to wholesalers and further distributes its products among retailers and to customers. The company also engages in the business of trading of vegetables such as potatoes and tomatoes. Peshwa Wheat Limited was founded in 2015 and is based in Indore, India.
